milestone.title: Hostinger Day 21 Submission - 2026-09-24
milestone.description: Close runtime acceptance and compile the evidence-bound BuildAndDo entry. Source completion is not submission completion.

issues.title: Day 21 - close self-hosted source and native acceptance
acceptance: The existing Hostinger readiness checks execute on the self-hosted GitLab runner.
Both declared PocketBase profiles execute all five native acceptance surfaces.
Failures, skips and unavailable dependencies remain explicit.

issues.title: Day 21 - capture the real browser challenge journey
acceptance: Public entry, auth, challenge, mission, evidence and operator readback execute on the selected candidate.
Every accepted browser step has a content hash and observation time.
No synthetic screenshot is accepted as deployed-browser evidence.

issues.title: Day 21 - bind evidence for all four Hostinger products
acceptance: Hostinger Agent, AI Builder, Web Hosting and VPS each have a distinct meaningful-use statement.
Each product statement is backed by at least one hashed observed artifact.
Product proof contains no credentials or private customer data.

issues.title: Day 21 - validate one nonsynthetic signal-to-verification replay
acceptance: Replay binds one candidate SHA, workspace, mission and dispatch.
Producer and verifier identities are distinct.
The replay status is CONSISTENT_CAPTURE and synthetic=false.

issues.title: Day 21 - compile and owner-review the Hostinger submission bundle
acceptance: The final public URL is frozen and resolves successfully.
The owner reviews the current official Hostinger form/rules before the external submission action.
External submission is performed only under explicit human authorization.
